description.value: An Indian Affair is an Indian restaurant and bistro in Langley's Willowbrook area serving a menu that blends traditional recipes with contemporary flair using fresh ingredients. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout, with vegetarian options and a bar, making it a viable stop for cyclists seeking a sit-down Indian meal. The website indicates multiple locations under the same brand.

address.value: 1672 Willowbrook Drive, Unit 146, Langley, BC V2Y 1A5
